handoff_instructions: M2-T07 'Webhook route handler' implemented. Files changed: packages/integrations/src/webhook-signing.ts (new: HMAC-SHA256 signWebhookBody/verifyWebhookSignature helpers + WebhookHeaders type); packages/integrations/src/providers/{voice,sms}-provider.ts (added verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, headers) to the VoiceProvider/SmsProvider interfaces); packages/integrations/src/fakes/fake-{voice,sms}-provider.ts (implement verifyWebhookSignature + expose signWebhook(rawBody) for building signed test requests, secret via constructor param, default 'fake-{voice,sms}-webhook-secret'); packages/integrations/src/index.ts (export webhook-signing); packages/integrations/test/fake-providers.test.ts (+5 tests: valid/missing/tampered/wrong-secret signatures, cross-provider secret isolation); apps/web/package.json (added @backoffice/integrations dep) and pnpm-lock.yaml; apps/web/src/server/providers.ts (new: server-only singleton accessors voiceProvider()/smsProvider(), currently returning the fakes -- real Twilio/Vapi adapters are a later task); apps/web/src/server/webhook-route.ts (new: shared handleProviderWebhook(adapter, request) -- verifies signature via the adapter first (401 on failure, nothing recorded), then JSON-parses the body (400 on parse failure), then calls adapter.ingestWebhook and records the receipt via runAs({type:'integration',...}) + recordWebhookReceipt from M2-T06, never trusting a tenant id from the payload); apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/voice/route.ts and .../sms/route.ts (new: thin POST handlers delegating to handleProviderWebhook); apps/web/test/webhooks.test.ts (new: 5 tests covering missing/invalid/tampered signature -> 401 and nothing recorded, valid signature -> 200 and recordWebhookReceipt called exactly once, unparseable body -> 400; mocks @backoffice/core and src/server/db, and stubs the 'server-only' marker package so src/server modules can be unit tested directly -- first test of a src/server module in this repo, so that stub is new). Tenant resolution and full communication-record persistence are out of scope here per the M2 blueprint (M2-T09). Lint, typecheck, and full test suites (integrations, core, web including the production-build/secret-bundle test) all pass. Next: M2-T08 'Caller matching service'.
